ALTER PROCEDURE DW.SP_DW_DIMGENERATIONALCOHORT
AS
BEGIN


TRUNCATE TABLE DW.DIMGENERATIONALCOHORT;

INSERT INTO DW.DimGenerationalCohort (
GenerationalCohortSK
,GenerationalCohortID
,GenerationalCohortName
,GenerationalCohortDescription
,LowerLimit
,UpperLimit
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,Currentindicator
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)
SELECT
'1' AS GenerationalCohortSK
,'S' AS GenerationalCohortID
,'SILENT' AS GenerationalCohortName
,'1928-1945' AS GenerationalCohortDescription
,'1928' AS LowerLimit
,'1945' AS UpperLimit
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,1 AS Currentindicator
,'Manual' AS SourceID
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
UNION

SELECT
'2' AS GenerationalCohortSK
,'B' AS GenerationalCohortID
,'BOOMERS' AS GenerationalCohortName
,'1946-1964' AS GenerationalCohortDescription
,'1946' AS LowerLimit
,'1964' AS UpperLimit
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,1 AS Currentindicator
,'Manual' AS SourceID
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
'3' AS GenerationalCohortSK
,'GX' AS GenerationalCohortID
,'GENERATION X' AS GenerationalCohortName
,'1965-1980' AS GenerationalCohortDescription
,'1965' AS LowerLimit
,'1980' AS UpperLimit
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,1 AS Currentindicator
,'Manual' AS SourceID
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
'4' AS GenerationalCohortSK
,'M' AS GenerationalCohortID
,'MILLENNIALS' AS GenerationalCohortName
,'1981-1996' AS GenerationalCohortDescription
,'1981' AS LowerLimit
,'1996' AS UpperLimit
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,1 AS Currentindicator
,'Manual' AS SourceID
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
'5' AS GenerationalCohortSK
,'GZ' AS GenerationalCohortID
,'GENERATION Z' AS GenerationalCohortName
,'1997-2021' AS GenerationalCohortDescription
,'1997' AS LowerLimit
,'2012' AS UpperLimit
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,1 AS Currentindicator
,'Manual' AS SourceID
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
UNION
SELECT
'6' AS GenerationalCohortSK
,'O' AS GenerationalCohortID
,'OTHERS' AS GenerationalCohortName
,'' AS GenerationalCohortDescription
,'0' AS LowerLimit
,'0' AS UpperLimit
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,1 AS Currentindicator
,'Manual' AS SourceID
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm



END
